name: AUTOPILOT.OI All 5 Money Agents
description_html:
All 5 Money Agents for Claude. $50 separately, $39 here.

  • Bill Agent: checks a medical bill against your insurance before you pay
  • Debt Agent: payoff plan and the script to ask for a lower rate
  • Subscription Agent: lists every recurring charge and drafts the cancel messages
  • Refund Agent: drafts refund requests that name your rights
  • Raise Agent: pay data, your number and a practice run

What you get: 5 Claude prompt kits (PDFs), each with the master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a 10 minute setup guide and a tracker.

How it works: you paste each prompt into a Claude Project and run it when you need it. It drafts, you check, decide and send. Nothing logs into your accounts or sends anything on its own.

You need: a Claude account. The free plan allows up to 5 Projects, enough for all 5.

Education only, not financial, legal or medical advice. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
